home.intro_text: Discover PGs, flats, houses, apartments and commercial spaces. Propertys Available brings property owners and tenants together in one convenient platform.
home.about_text: Propertys Available is a property discovery and rental management platform designed to connect property owners with tenants. Owners can list and manage properties, handle tenant requests, organise rental agreements, track rent and deposits, and manage property-related bills. Tenants can explore available properties, send rental requests, access agreements, view payment details and manage their rental journey from one place.

“User” means anyone accessing the Platform. “Property” includes a house, flat, room, paying guest accommodation, hostel or other rental premises.
“Services” means the digital features made available through the Platform.

Depending on the features enabled, Services may include account registration, property and tenant records, rent and deposit tracking, payment-status records, rent receipts, rental document generation or storage, reminders, communications and links to third-party services.

Unless a separate written agreement expressly says otherwise, the Platform is a technology and record-management service. It is not the owner, landlord, tenant, real-estate broker, property manager, bank, escrow agent, police authority, identity-certification authority or legal adviser. The Platform does not become a party to a rental agreement merely because users create, upload or store it.

We do not guarantee property availability, ownership, condition, legality or suitability, or the accuracy of user-submitted information. We do not guarantee that an Owner or Tenant will perform their obligations. Users must independently verify relevant facts and make their own decisions.

You must be legally competent to enter into a binding contract under applicable law to use contractual rental services. You must provide accurate, current and complete registration information and keep it updated. Do not impersonate another person or create an account using false information.

You are responsible for keeping passwords, OTPs, devices and account credentials confidential and for activity carried out through your account. Notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access. We may request reasonable verification before allowing account access or sensitive changes.

You must not sell, rent, transfer or share your account without our written permission. We may refuse registration or restrict an account where reasonably necessary for security, legal compliance or enforcement of these Terms.

If you act as an Owner, you confirm that you own the property or have valid authority to advertise, rent or manage it. You must ensure property descriptions, photographs, rent, deposit, availability, amenities and location details are accurate and not misleading.

You must comply with applicable laws, building rules and local requirements; provide accurate payment instructions; acknowledge payments fairly and promptly; not list property you are unauthorized to offer; and not use the Platform for unlawful discrimination, harassment or screening.

You are responsible for property inspection and maintenance, verifying your authority to rent, setting lawful rental terms, preparing and executing suitable agreements, and meeting your obligations to tenants. The Platform does not perform these duties unless a separate written service expressly provides otherwise.

If you act as a Tenant, you confirm that information and documents you provide are accurate. You must use the property lawfully and follow the rental agreement and applicable rules; pay rent, deposits and agreed charges to the correct recipient; not submit false payment confirmations or altered documents; and respect the property and other occupants.

You are responsible for inspecting the property, understanding the rental terms, confirming the Owner’s identity and authority and payment details, and obtaining a signed agreement where appropriate before paying money or moving in.

Users are responsible for text, images, documents, reviews, messages, property details and other material they submit (“User Content”). The Platform may allow users to record rent, deposits, fees, utility charges, payments, dues and transaction references. Unless a payment feature is expressly enabled and identified as such, the Platform is only a record-keeping tool and does not collect, hold, transfer or guarantee funds.

A payment entry, screenshot, receipt or status entered by a user may not independently prove that funds have cleared or reached the intended recipient. Owners and tenants must verify payments with their bank, payment provider or the other party. The Platform may generate receipts, rent statements, reminders, summaries, templates or draft rental documents using information entered by users. Review every generated document for accuracy before signing, issuing, relying on or sharing it.

A generated template is not legal advice and may not satisfy every state-specific or local requirement for stamping, registration, notarization or evidentiary use. 10. OTP, IDENTITY AND VERIFICATION

We may provide mobile OTP verification or facilitate identity, address, tenant or police-verification services through an authorized provider or competent authority, where legally permitted. You agree to provide accurate information and complete required consent and verification steps.

Verification scope, availability, timing and results depend on the provider, authority, records and applicable law. An OTP verifies access to a phone number or communication channel at that time; it does not prove identity, property ownership, creditworthiness or character. 1. INTRODUCTION

Welcome to PROPERTYS AVAILABLE. We provides digital tools and services to help property owners, landlords, tenants and residents manage rental relationships and related records. Depending on the features made available, users may create accounts, add properties and tenants, record rent and deposit details, generate receipts, store or share rental documents, receive reminders and communicate about rental matters.

This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why and how we use it, when it may be shared, how long we retain it, and the choices and rights available to users. It applies when you use our website, Android or iOS application, customer support channels, or related services.

Please read this Policy together with the Platform’s Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with this Policy, do not use features that require personal data. Where consent is the legal basis for processing, you may withdraw it as described below; withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out lawfully before withdrawal.
2. WHO THIS POLICY APPLIES TO

This Policy applies to website visitors, registered property owners and landlords, property managers, tenants, PG or hostel owners and residents, and individuals whose information is submitted to the Platform by an authorized user in connection with a rental relationship.

If you provide another person’s information (for example, a tenant’s name or contact details), you must have the authority or lawful basis to do so and must provide that person with any notice required by law. Do not upload another person’s identity documents or sensitive information unless the relevant feature requires it and you are authorized to provide it.
3. PERSONAL DATA WE MAY COLLECT
The information collected depends on the features you use. We aim to collect only information reasonably necessary for the stated purpose.
3.1 Account and contact information: name, mobile number, email address, profile image (if provided), account identifier, login and authentication data, language preference and account settings.

3.2 Property owner and manager information: contact details, property address, property type, property photographs and descriptions, ownership or authorization information where needed, rent and deposit amounts, availability, and property-management records.

3.3 Tenant and resident information: name, contact details, current or permanent address, rental property, tenancy start and end dates, rent amount, deposit details, occupancy or emergency contact details where provided, and rent-related records.

3.4 Identity and verification information: the type of identity document, verification status, masked or limited document details, reference numbers and results returned by an authorized verification provider. The exact data depends on the verification method and applicable law. We will not request Aadhaar information unless the relevant service is legally permitted and the required process and consent are in place.

3.5 Rental documents: rent agreements, receipts, notices, property-related documents, identity or address documents where lawfully required, and other files that users choose or are authorized to upload.

3.6 Payment and transaction information: payment amount, date, transaction or reference ID, payment status, refund status and related accounting records. If payments are handled by a payment gateway, the gateway may collect card, UPI, bank or other payment credentials directly. We do not intend to store complete card credentials or banking passwords on our systems.

3.7 Technical and usage information: device type, operating system, app version, browser type, IP address, log data, crash reports, approximate location where permitted, pages or features used, and cookie or similar technology identifiers.
3.8 Communications: messages or requests sent to customer support, feedback, complaints, and records needed to respond to you.
4. HOW WE USE PERSONAL DATA
We may use personal data, as permitted by applicable law, to:
a) create, authenticate and administer accounts;
b) verify mobile numbers and protect account access;
c) connect owners, managers and tenants for a rental relationship;
d) manage property, tenancy, rent, deposit and payment records;
e) generate rent receipts, statements and rental documents;
f) send rent reminders, service notices, OTPs and security alerts;
g) provide customer support and resolve disputes;
h) detect fraud, misuse and security incidents;
i) maintain, troubleshoot and improve the Platform;
j) comply with legal obligations and respond to lawful requests; and
k) enforce our Terms and protect the rights, safety and property of users and the Platform.
We will not use personal data for a new purpose that is incompatible with the original purpose unless we provide any notice and obtain any consent or other lawful basis required by applicable law.
5. INFORMATION SHARED BETWEEN OWNERS AND TENANTS

The Platform is designed to support rental administration. When an owner adds a tenant to a property, or a tenant joins or accepts a rental relationship, certain information may be visible to the other party according to the feature, account role, settings and permissions.

5.1 Information an owner may see: tenant name and contact details, tenancy dates, rent and deposit details, payment status or records, receipts, and documents the tenant has chosen or authorized to share for the rental relationship.

5.2 Information a tenant may see: owner or manager name and contact details, property details, agreed rent and deposit amounts, tenancy dates, payment instructions or status, rent receipts, and rental documents made available to the tenant.

5.3 Access controls: we may use role-based permissions and account controls to limit access. Users should review information before uploading or sharing it. Do not use information obtained through the Platform for marketing, harassment, discrimination, public posting or any purpose unrelated to the rental relationship unless separately authorized by law.

5.4 User responsibility: the owner and tenant are responsible for the accuracy of information they submit and for their own decisions about entering into, performing or ending a rental arrangement. The Platform is a technology and record-management service; unless expressly stated in a separate written agreement, it is not a party to the rental agreement and does not independently verify every statement made by a user.
6. PAYMENTS, RENT RECORDS AND RECEIPTS

The Platform may allow users to record payments made outside the Platform or, if enabled, initiate payments through a third-party payment provider. A record entered by a user is not necessarily proof that funds have cleared or been received. Users should verify payment status with their bank, payment provider or the other party.

Where a payment provider is used, that provider’s terms and privacy notice also apply. We may receive transaction references, amounts, status and limited information needed to reconcile payments, provide support and maintain records. We do not control the independent privacy practices of payment providers.
7. OTP, LOGIN AND ACCOUNT SECURITY

We may send one-time passwords (OTPs) or verification codes by SMS, email or another supported channel to register accounts, verify contact details, authenticate login, recover accounts or confirm sensitive actions. Communication providers may process your mobile number or email address to deliver these messages.

Never share an OTP, password or login link with another person, including anyone claiming to be Platform support. Contact us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access. We may temporarily restrict access or request additional verification to protect an account.
8. IDENTITY, ADDRESS AND POLICE VERIFICATION

If the Platform offers identity, address, tenant or police-verification facilitation, the service may be provided by an authorized third party or competent authority. The information required, process, availability and outcome depend on the service provider and applicable law.

We will describe the relevant data and purpose at the point of collection and obtain consent or other lawful authorization where required. We do not guarantee that a verification result is complete, current or error-free, and a verification status is not a guarantee of a person’s character, conduct or suitability as a tenant or owner. Users should not treat it as a substitute for their own lawful due diligence.
9. LOCATION, COOKIES AND DEVICE PERMISSIONS

The website may use cookies or similar technologies for login sessions, preferences, security, analytics and website functionality. You can manage cookies through your browser; disabling some cookies may affect features.

The mobile app may request permissions such as notifications, camera, photos/files or location when a feature needs them—for example, uploading a document, taking a property photograph, receiving a rent reminder or finding nearby properties. You can manage permissions in your device settings. If location is used, we will use it for the feature and purpose explained at the time of permission request, subject to applicable law.
10. WHEN WE SHARE PERSONAL DATA
We may share limited personal data:
a) with the owner, tenant or manager connected to the relevant rental relationship, as described in Section 5;
b) with hosting, cloud storage, database, analytics, SMS, email, customer support, payment, identity-verification and security providers who process data for us;
c) with professional advisers, auditors or insurers where reasonably necessary;
d) with courts, regulators, law-enforcement bodies or government authorities when required by law or valid legal process;
e) in connection with a merger, financing, restructuring or transfer of business, subject to appropriate safeguards; or
f) with your direction or consent.

We do not sell personal data to third parties for their own independent marketing. We require service providers handling data on our behalf to use it only for authorized services and to apply appropriate confidentiality and security measures, subject to contract and law.
11. CROSS-BORDER PROCESSING

Some service providers may store or process information on servers located outside your state or India. Where personal data is transferred outside India, we will comply with applicable Indian data-protection requirements and any restrictions or conditions imposed by the Government of India. We will take reasonable steps to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place.
12. DATA SECURITY

We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss or misuse. Depending on the service, safeguards may include access controls, role-based permissions, encryption in transit or at rest where appropriate, secure hosting, logging, backups, vulnerability management and restricted staff access.

No website, app, network or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. You are responsible for keeping your device and credentials secure. If you believe your account or data has been compromised, contact us using the details in Section 19.
13. DATA RETENTION AND DELETION

We retain personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, to provide the service, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, maintain accounting and transaction records, meet legal obligations, prevent fraud and protect security. Retention periods may differ by data type and legal requirement.

You may request deletion of your account or personal data through the app (if that feature is available) or by contacting us. We will assess and respond in accordance with applicable law. Some information may need to be retained where required or permitted by law, for legal claims, security, fraud prevention, financial records or other legitimate purposes. Where appropriate, data may be erased, anonymized or securely restricted instead of immediately deleted from every backup.
14. YOUR RIGHTS AND CHOICES

Subject to applicable law, you may have rights to request access to information about personal data being processed, correction or completion of inaccurate or incomplete data, erasure, withdrawal of consent, and grievance redressal. You may also have the right to nominate another individual to exercise rights in the event of death or incapacity, where provided by applicable law.

You can update certain profile information through your account. To exercise a privacy right or withdraw consent, contact us using Section 19 and specify the account and request. We may need to verify your identity before acting. Withdrawal of consent does not affect processing already carried out lawfully before withdrawal and may mean that some features can no longer be provided.
15. CHILDREN'S PERSONAL DATA

The Platform is intended for people who are legally able to use the relevant rental services. We do not knowingly seek to collect children’s personal data except where permitted by law and with any verifiable parental or guardian consent required. If you believe a child’s personal data has been provided to us improperly, contact us so we can review and take appropriate action.
16. DATA BREACHES

If a personal data breach occurs, we will take steps to contain, investigate and mitigate it, and provide notices to affected individuals and authorities where and when required by applicable law. We may also take steps to secure accounts, reset credentials or temporarily suspend affected features.
17. THIRD-PARTY LINKS AND SERVICES

The Platform may link to third-party websites, applications or services. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, not this Policy. We encourage you to review those policies before providing information to them. A link does not mean that we endorse or control the third party.
18. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY

We may update this Policy to reflect changes in our services, data practices, technology or applicable law. We will publish the updated version with a revised “Last Updated” date and provide additional notice or obtain consent where required.
